made of 100 percent Moomoo Milk.
A very sweet condiment.\n
People in Paldea seem to favor the\n
sweet varieties over the unsweetened.

It’s thanks to Scovillain that this sauce\n
gets its signature mouth-tingling burn.

seasoning,\n
unsurprisingly.\r

packing very\n

It goes especially well with fruit and\n
is easy to incorporate into a sandwich.
A very sweet condiment.\n
Folks in Paldea seem to love the varieties\n
that really let the sweetness sing.

very sweet and very\n
tart flavor.\r

convenient go-to.
A condiment that’s very\n
sweet and likewise very\n
sour.\r
Take care when adding it to sandwiches,\n
as the sweet side can overwhelm.
A condiment with sour and bitter notes.\n
It’s surprisingly useful, as it makes\n
a nice counterpoint to oilier foods.
A condiment offering\n
faint notes of sour\n
and bitter flavors.\r
The most prized varieties are the ones\n
Smoliv love the smell of--such oils’\n
quality is assured.
A very sour condiment.\n
Vinegars derived from grapes\n
are popular in Paldea.\r
Highly effective when used to\n
add just a light note of flavor.
A legendary condiment\n
told of only in\n
books.\r
Word has it that one taste of its sweet\n
flavor stimulates the digestive system and\n
cures a lack of appetite.
One of the condiments\n
spoken of as\n
legends.\r
Its mellow saltiness is said to be\n
tremendously effective when it comes to\n
promoting health.
This surpassingly sour condiment is\n
said to be super effective in helping\n
the eater recover from exhaustion.\r
Only a scant few people know it exists.
A legendary condiment\n
with a deeply bitter\n
taste.\r
It’s said to dramatically bolster a body’s\n
immune defenses, though that hasn’t\n
been proven.
The legendary condiment\n
said to have the mightiest\n
of all spicy flavors.\r
It’s said that a single bite\n
will kick the metabolism\n
into high gear immediately.
This bitter-tasting ingredient is simple\n
and straightforward--just add it to all\n
kinds of other ingredients for a\r
delightfully crunchy time.
This very tart ingredient has a lot\n
of savory elements to it, making it\n
popular with many Pokémon.
A very tart ingredient. Some varieties\n
are also very sweet, and these are prized\n
above all others by the people of Paldea.
A tart and bitter ingredient.\n
Using it together with rich-tasting\n
ingredients in a sandwich will really\r
make the most of a cucumber’s fresh-veggie\n
aroma.

pickling veggies in a flavorful\n
brine made from spices and vinegar.
This spicy veggie is indispensable\n
to many sandwiches. It goes well\n
with rich ingredients.
An ingredient with\n
some sweetness to\n
it.\r
Its spiciness and fragrance are milder\n
than those of other onions, making it\n
a pleasant bite.
An ingredient with some bitterness.\n
When sliced, it adds a nice accent\n
to a sandwich.
An ingredient with some bitterness--but\n
its bitter notes and overall flavor are\n
pleasantly mild compared to its green\r
cousin.
An ingredient with some bitterness.\n
It’s not much different from its red\n
counterpart in flavor, but mixing\r
the colors makes a feast for the\n
eyes.
An ingredient with sweet notes--though its\n
flavor is very mild. The avocado’s richness,\n
however, makes it satisfying to eat.
This very salty ingredient has been\n
cooked just shy of charred, making it\n
burst with fragrance and tasty flavor.
A very salty ingredient-and that\n
very saltiness is what makes it such\n
a nice companion to veggies.

ham, but the difference is prosciutto is\n
not cooked after it is cured, giving it a\r
fun freshness.
A very salty and spicy ingredient.\n
This type of sausage has\n
particularly robust salty flavor,\r
and the spicier varieties are extra\n
popular.

The balance between the potent\n
saltiness and the herbs’ bitterness\r
make this sausage a pleasure.

thing to add if you want to make\n
your sandwich truly filling.

that unmistakable smoky flavor.\n
It pairs exceptionally well with veggies.

with sour seasonings.
An ingredient with a touch of saltiness.\n
It’s full of nutrients and can be enjoyed\n
with all sorts of seasonings.
A very salty ingredient and\n
a popular dish in Paldea.\n
It’s undeniably filling.

beloved by many Pokémon.

sandwich visually striking.

thin to make it easy to add into a\n
sandwich.

light touch of sweetness as well. It\n
goes well with rich ingredients.
